    What's happening to Rob Reiner's son?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    Rob Reiner's son, Nick Reiner, is facing two counts of first-degree murder for the December 2025 stabbing deaths of his parents, Rob and Michele Reiner, in their Los Angeles home; he pleaded not guilty in February 2026 and is being held without bail, with a preliminary hearing scheduled for April 29, 2026, as he awaits trial for the capital offense. 
    Key Details of the Case:
    • Charges:
      Two counts of first-degree murder with a special circumstance for multiple murders, carrying potential life imprisonment or the death penalty. 
    • Arrest:
      Nick Reiner was arrested on December 14, 2025, shortly after his parents were found dead from multiple stab wounds by their daughter. 
    • Court Proceedings:
      • He appeared in court in February 2026, where a plea of not guilty was entered on his behalf. 
      • His next court date for a preliminary hearing, where prosecutors will present evidence, is set for April 29, 2026. 
    • Background:
      Nick Reiner has publicly struggled with drug addiction and homelessness, which his father, Rob Reiner, has spoken about in the past. 
    Current Status:
    Nick Reiner remains in custody without bail, awaiting further legal proceedings in the high-profile case.

      Who found Rob Reiner dead?
      On the afternoon of December 14, Rob and Michele Reiner's daughter Romy discovered her father's body in the master bedroom of their Brentwood home. Her roommate, with whom she lived across the street from her parents' house, called 911 at 3:38 p.m. after Romy fled the residence.

      Did Rob Reiner have kids with Penny Marshall?
      An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
      AI Overview
      Yes, Rob Reiner and Penny Marshall had one child together, their adopted daughter Tracy Reiner, who was biologically Penny Marshall's daughter from a previous relationship; Rob adopted her during their marriage (1971-1981) and raised her as his own, remaining close even after their divorce.
       
      Key Details:
      • Tracy Reiner:
        She is an actress and producer, known for roles in A League of Their Own (directed by Marshall) and When Harry Met Sally (directed by Reiner). 
      • Family Life:
        Reiner later married Michele Singer, with whom he had three more children: Jake, Nick, and Romy. Tracy remained a close part of Reiner's extended family.
